usage: Used for a person who buys and sells goods, usually in a business or trading context.
A fairly formal and general word; it can refer to traders, business people, or people involved in commerce.
Often appears in compounds and set phrases related to trade, business, import/export, and market activity.
Not as everyday as 售貨員 or 老闆 when talking about shop staff or business owners; it sounds more like a trade/business role.
